 Miami Heat Cleveland Cavaliers The  Miami Heat  (5-6) and  Cleveland Cavaliers  (6-6) meet for the first of three matchups this regular season and Miami’s second NBA Cup game after defeating Indiana on October 30. Last season, the teams split the series, 2-2. The Heat are 82-55 all-time versus Cleveland during the regular season, including 52-18 at home and 30-37 on the road.
--> The  Miami Heat  (5-6) and  Cleveland Cavaliers  (6-6) meet for the first of three matchups this regular season and Miami’s second NBA Cup game after defeating Indiana on October 30. Last season, the teams split the series, 2-2. The Heat are 82-55 all-time versus Cleveland during the regular season, including 52-18 at home and 30-37 on the road.
 The Cavaliers, coming off their first Conference Finals appearance since LeBron James' final season with them in 2018, have gotten off to an underwhelming start, much like the Heat. The Cavs are most recently coming off a win over the defending champion New York Knicks.
--> The Cavaliers, coming off their first Conference Finals appearance since LeBron James' final season with them in 2018, have gotten off to an underwhelming start, much like the Heat. The Cavs are most recently coming off a win over the defending champion New York Knicks.
 The Heat are coming off a,  115-109, win against the Utah Jazz. After going up by as much as 23 points, the Heat allowed a short-handed Jazz team, (missing four of five starters), to get back into the game in the fourth quarter, but were able to close them out.
--> The Heat are coming off a,  115-109, win against the Utah Jazz. After going up by as much as 23 points, the Heat allowed a short-handed Jazz team, (missing four of five starters), to get back into the game in the fourth quarter, but were able to close them out.
 Giannis Antetokounmpo finished with 30 points, converting on 12 of 21 shot attempts, along with 11 rebounds and four assists. Davion Mitchell ended up with 19 points, eight assists, five rebounds and two steals.
--> Giannis Antetokounmpo finished with 30 points, converting on 12 of 21 shot attempts, along with 11 rebounds and four assists. Davion Mitchell ended up with 19 points, eight assists, five rebounds and two steals.
